用 ↑↓ 調整分類與主題的順序，書櫃也會跟著變。: Use ↑↓ to reorder categories and topics; the shelf follows.
開啟後可在卡片內捲動、點擊；關閉時拖曳與縮放畫布不會被卡住: When on, you can scroll and click inside the card; when off, dragging and zooming the canvas won't get stuck
